status: written after metadata/member audit and history review, before reading the complete discovery outcome panel
labels: Frozen 5 legacy plus 10 mixed history routes; no refit or label adjustment from discovery/assessment outcomes
primary: n>=3, m>=2 actual A/B/C blocks; inherited n2 deferral kept in attempted coverage separately
secondary: actual source matched and all three replaceable blocks pairwise history-Q mean difference<=3
contexts: same-source whole teams versus new-source replaceable blocks with mixed-source fixed backgrounds remain separate; those settings are not pooled
axes: no-Q original geometry versus new shape criteria
C-minus-B B8/D10 direction, p10 and deterioration
source-task reported time separately from quality and geometry
support: Use actual unique A/B/C team keys and worker bitsets, images and buildings. Within-class table deduplicates unordered A/B pairs and counts only A/B teams/people. Its team-score mean/p10/worst uses unique A/B endpoint teams per image.
weighting: Actual-event means within image; image means within building; buildings equal. Quantiles are computed within image before the same hierarchy. No independent-team pseudo-N or zero-filled missing quality.
search: Retain all ordered directions plus exact n/m, difficulty, n band, replacement fraction and background-policy strata, including weak/negative rows. This is systematic analysis of the sampled finite request frame, not enumeration of all possible teams/compositions.

candidate_review_buckets.name: broad direction
candidate_review_buckets.suggested_support: at least8 images/3 buildings and16 actual ABC events; inspect positive/negative building counts and failures
candidate_review_buckets.effect: quality gain/loss or clear geometric separation with usable within-class stability

candidate_review_buckets.name: conditional hypothesis
candidate_review_buckets.suggested_support: at least3 images/2 buildings and8 events, with exact difficulty/n/m/source scope; smaller support remains a named case rather than a general rule
candidate_review_buckets.effect: clear reproducible direction or structure pattern worth new-member/new-building checking

candidate_review_buckets.name: within-class useful stability
candidate_review_buckets.suggested_support: at least5 images/3 buildings and16 unique A/B comparisons where available
candidate_review_buckets.effect: joint/shape stability, actual absQ/shape tail, unique-team quality level and failures reported jointly

candidate_review_buckets.name: counterexamples
candidate_review_buckets.suggested_support: never discard for low support; state actual support
candidate_review_buckets.effect: same class large change; stable but low actual quality; Q-close yet shape-changed; original-node criterion versus new-shape disagreement; high-K capacity loss

threshold_role: Support buckets prioritize review, not acceptance gates or p-value rules; every row and failed/unsupported stratum remains available
assessment: Only after discovery patterns are reviewed will root freeze exact directions/n/m/conditions and failure controls for assessment. This script does not read assessment.
comparability: Different learned methods sampled different actual teams/cores/n/m; aggregate method differences are not isolated causal algorithm improvements. Need common context/pair or explicit residual analysis before such a claim.
history_Q: Condition-specific history-Q field follows frozen block summary. Missing historical feature opportunity is not low ability; target individual annotation Q is post-answer mechanism information, not a matching variable.
difficulty: Existing nonblind reference-aligned difficulty review, not an automatic precapture predictor for arbitrary new images
